_description: Defaults for the scripts in scripts/. Pass this file (or a copy with only the values you change) with --config; each script reads its own sections and ignores the rest. Server settings are environment variables, listed under _environment.

_environment.GMX_MCP_GMX: path to gmx (default: gmx, then gmx_mpi on PATH)
_environment.GMX_MCP_WORKDIR: only allow paths below this directory (default: unrestricted)
_environment.GMX_MCP_HOME: where jobs/, runs/, results/ and logs/ are created (default: repository root, or <GMX_MCP_WORKDIR>/gromacs_mcp when a sandbox is set)
_environment.GMX_MCP_MIN_FREE_MB: refuse new jobs below this free disk space (default: 500)
_environment.GMX_MCP_MAX_CHARS: longer text fields in results are shortened (default: 20000)
_environment.GMX_MCP_SCRIPT_DIRS: extra folders jobs may run scripts from, besides scripts/ (os.pathsep separated)
